$about: The align-engine manifest (ADR-005). The align/update/self-verify skills read THIS to know what an aligned repo must have at a given version - instead of hardcoding it in prose or JS. Paths are the client layout - identical to the standard/ tree in this repo. since names the release that first shipped an entry; unreleased rides the next cut. An aligned repo carries a copy of this file at its pinned version; `scripts/self-verify.mjs` checks the repo against it and reports drift as a number. Method docs are adopted BY REFERENCE, never copied: the `references` section names them at their home in the standards repo (ADR-004/023) - self-verify notes them, checks no files. The repo's copy MAY carry a top-level `profile` field (core|scale, ADR-011) written at align time - self-verify uses it as the default profile. The normative source is SPEC.md; each entry cites the rule it enforces (`rule`).

adaptRules.copy: ship verbatim; the repo gets a byte-for-byte copy (guards, templates that carry no repo-specific content)
adaptRules.merge: combine the standard's content with what the repo already has, keeping both (ignore files, CI that already has jobs)
adaptRules.fill-from-repo: scaffold the shell from the standard, then author the body from THIS repo's reality - never blind-copy the example prose (ARCHITECTURE, PRODUCT, specs)
adaptRules.reference: do not copy; link to the living standard - always latest (ADR-004/025 - the standard's own decisions reach clients by reference)
